# `events`

Game events with priorities and cancellation. A mod subscribes with `subscribe`; the host then calls the exported `guest.handle-event` once per event and subscription. Handlers run on the game / server main thread, one at a time.

Package `blockheads:api@0.2.0` · Lua table `bh.events` · [WIT source](https://github.com/Blockheads-Club/mod-sdk/blob/dev/wit/blockheads-api/events.wit)

Uses: `types.{mod-id, priority, value, api-error, pos}`, `players.{player}`

## Types

### `subscription` <Badge type="info" text="type" />

```txt
type subscription = u32;
```

Identifies one subscription of the calling mod.

### `event-kind` <Badge type="info" text="enum" />

The built-in events. Cases are only ever appended (0.1: player-join .. world-save; 0.2: player-pre-login .. player-move).

| Case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `player-join` | A player finished joining (after approval and the world summary). Server only. |
| `player-quit` | A player left or was kicked. Server only. |
| `chat` | A chat message, before it is shown or broadcast. Cancellable; the text can be replaced. |
| `command` | A `/command` line, before any command handler runs. Cancellable (cancel = swallow the command). |
| `tick` | One world step (0.2 s on the server). Fires after the world update. |
| `world-loaded` | The world finished loading; world functions are usable from now on. |
| `world-save` | The world is being saved (fires before and after, see `save-phase`). |
| `player-pre-login` | (0.2) A player passed every vanilla join check and is about to be approved. Cancellable: the player is rejected with `reject-reason` (vanilla clients show their own text for it). Server only. |
| `block-place` | (0.2) A player places a block or item into a tile. Cancellable: the tile stays as it is and the client is resynced exactly as for a protected tile. Server only. |
| `block-break` | (0.2) A player removes a block, its contents, water or a back wall. Cancellable (same resync). Server only. |
| `block-changed` | (0.2) A tile changed, by a player or by the simulation (growth, physics, NPCs). Monitor only: the outcome is ignored because cancelling simulation changes would desync clients. Server only. |
| `object-place` | (0.2) A player places a workbench or an interaction object (chest, sign, door, bed, ...). Cancellable. Server only. |
| `damage` | (0.2) A blockhead is about to take damage. Cancellable; the amount can be replaced. Server only. |
| `death` | (0.2) A blockhead died. Server only. |
| `player-move` | (0.2) A player's blockhead entered another tile. Server only. |

### `reject-reason` <Badge type="info" text="enum" />

(0.2) Vanilla rejection reasons a `player-pre-login` handler may choose (the 0x26 reason byte in brackets).

| Case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `client-too-old` | [3] The client is too old. |
| `server-full` | [5] The server is full. |
| `blacklisted` | [6] Blacklisted. |
| `not-whitelisted` | [7] Not on the whitelist. |
| `incorrect-password` | [10] Wrong password. |
| `kicked` | [11] Kicked. The default when a handler cancels without choosing. |
| `banned` | [12] Banned. |
| `invalid-username` | [14] Invalid user name. |
| `still-loading` | [15] The server is still loading. |

### `mutation` <Badge type="info" text="variant" />

A change a handler wants to make to a mutable event.

| Case | Payload | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `chat-text` | `string` | Replace the chat text (only for `chat`). |
| `custom-payload` | `value` | Replace the custom payload (only for `custom`). |
| `reject-reason` | `reject-reason` | (0.2) The rejection reason (only for `player-pre-login`). |
| `damage-amount` | `f32` | (0.2) The damage amount, finite and &gt;= 0 (only for `damage`). |

### `outcome` <Badge type="info" text="record" />

What a handler returns. Ignored for `monitor` handlers and for events that are not cancellable.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cancelled` | `bool` | The new cancelled state. Returning `false` on a cancelled event un-cancels it. |
| `mutation` | `option<mutation>` | An optional change; a mutation that does not fit the event is ignored with a warning. |

## Functions

### `subscribe` <Badge type="info" text="function" />

```txt
subscribe: func(kind: event-kind, priority: priority, ignore-cancelled: bool) -> result<subscription, api-error>;
```

Subscribes to a built-in event. `ignore-cancelled` skips this handler while the event is cancelled.

### `subscribe-custom` <Badge type="info" text="function" />

```txt
subscribe-custom: func(name: string, priority: priority, ignore-cancelled: bool) -> result<subscription, api-error>;
```

Subscribes to a custom event by its full name (`<mod-id>:<name>`). Any mod's events may be subscribed.

### `unsubscribe` <Badge type="info" text="function" />

```txt
unsubscribe: func(sub: subscription) -> bool;
```

Removes a subscription. Returns false if it did not exist.

### `fire-custom` <Badge type="info" text="function" />

```txt
fire-custom: func(name: string, payload: value) -> result<bool, api-error>;
```

Fires a custom event. `name` must start with the caller's mod id and a colon. Listeners run synchronously with the normal priority rules; the result is true if the event ended up cancelled. Handlers of mods that are on the call stack (including the caller) get the event after the outermost call returns, with their outcome ignored.
